summary: Looks up audio commentary channel parameters (two DWORD values and two pointers) by channel index. Channel 0 selects the default commentary globals; channel 1 selects the TV commentary globals; any other index returns 1 as an invalid-channel error without writing outputs.

operations.description: Initialize result to 1 as the invalid-channel error default.
If the channel index is greater than 1, return 1 immediately without writing any output.
Within the valid range, branch on the channel index: a non-zero index (1) selects TV commentary parameters, a zero index selects default commentary parameters.
Channel 1 (TV): write dword_5BF8D0 and dword_5BF8D4 to the two output DWORDs and off_5BF8E8 and off_5BF8F0 to the two output pointers.
Channel 0 (default): write dword_5BF8C8 and dword_5BF8CC to the two output DWORDs and off_5BF8D8 and off_5BF8E0 to the two output pointers.
Return 0 when the channel index was valid, 1 when it was out of range.

unresolved: Meaning of the two DWORD values and two pointers per channel is not established; the referenced globals are opaque configuration data.
The parameter contract with callers SceneGraphQuery and GlobalVTableDispatchWithQuery is not resolved.
